chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī Najrān, from ʿĀṣim ibn Ḥumayd, from Muḥammad ibn Qays, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام ruled concerning the old man and the old woman that they are to be flogged one hundred lashes, and he ruled stoning for the muḥṣan. And he ruled concerning the virgin man and the virgin woman, when they commit zina, one hundred lashes and banishment for one year to a place other than their town. And they are the two who have had the marriage contract concluded, but he has not entered upon her.

key_terms.الرَّجْمَ: stoning as a prescribed hadd punishment in this ruling
key_terms.الزِّنَى: illicit sexual intercourse subject to hadd punishment
key_terms.الْبِكْرَةِ: the virgin woman, here paired with the male counterpart under the same ruling
key_terms.الْبِكْرِ: the virgin man, here meaning one not yet having consummated marriage
key_terms.الْمُحْصَنِ: a legally protected married person falling under the ruling of rajm in this context
key_terms.نَفْيَ سَنَةٍ: banishment or exile for one year

ai.seo_question: What ruling did Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام give for zina by the muḥṣan and by those married but not yet consummated?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal ruling attributed to Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام regarding hadd punishments for zina in different marital and social circumstances. It distinguishes between the muḥṣan and those whose marriage contract has been concluded but consummation has not occurred, showing graded legal consequences in Shiʿi fiqh.
